precepts.text: If thy nearest kin entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, thou shalt not consent unto him nor hearken unto him.
precepts.point: Joshua and Deuteronomy double it: neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them; and if thy brother or son or wife entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, thou shalt not consent. Wherever you are, do not go trying to find out how the nations worship their gods.

note.label: Exodus 23: Righteous Judgment, the Three Feasts, and the Angel of the Covenant

precepts.why:
“If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers”, whether their gods be “nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him”.

That is what making mention of other gods means: going to serve them. Not even your nearest kin can entice you to it. Wherever you are, from one end of the earth to the other, do not go trying to find out how the nations worship their gods.

precepts.text: Mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned, and avoid them.
precepts.point: Going contrary to the laws of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, or of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you, and secretly enticing others to follow, is how one turns people away from the Lord; those men and those women have to be put out from among the body.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
Under the kingdom, the prophet or dreamer of dreams who spoke to turn Israel away from the Lord was put to death. Today Israel is in the land of its oppressors and cannot exact that judgment, and no kind of violence is advocated. What is done today is this: “Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.”

The one who speaks “to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in” is marked and avoided. Going contrary to the laws of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, or of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you, and secretly enticing others to follow, is how one turns people away from the Lord. Those men and those women have to be put out from among the body. That is how “So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee” is kept today.

precepts.text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law; the doctrine is the law.
precepts.point: Going contrary to the laws of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, or of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you, and secretly enticing others to follow, is how one turns people away from the Lord; those men and those women have to be put out from among the body.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
“For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.” The doctrine which ye have learned, the doctrine that divisions and offences are marked against, is the law. Good doctrine and the law are one and the same: forsake ye not my law.

So the one who causes divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine is the one going contrary to the laws: of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you. To speak to turn people away from the Lord their God is to speak against his law, and it is out of the way of that law that the deceiver thrusts them.

precepts.text: The deceived and the deceiver are his; the judgment is the Most High's, not ours.
precepts.point: Going contrary to the laws of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, or of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you, and secretly enticing others to follow, is how one turns people away from the Lord; those men and those women have to be put out from among the body.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
“With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.” Israel today cannot put the prophet or dreamer of dreams to death; we are in the land of our oppressors, and no kind of violence is advocated. The judgment belongs to the Most High, not to us: both the deceived and the deceiver are his, and he will deal with them.

What is ours is to mark them and avoid them, and to put those men and those women out from among the body. The one who has spoken to turn you away from the Lord your God is left in the hand of the one whose he is, with whom is strength and wisdom.

precepts.text: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; being enticed to serve other gods is evil, so follow them not.
precepts.point: This is why Leviticus 5:1 is opened at the start of class: if you know of anything, you are supposed to utter it. Many grew up on snitches get stitches, but in repentance we have to understand that concealing sin is part of why Israel is in the condition it is in, and we have to teach righteousness. It is that simple.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment”. Being enticed to serve other gods is evil, so follow them not. Whether it is a multitude, or the one closest to you, thy brother, thy son, thy daughter, the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend which is as thine own soul, saying “Let us go and serve other gods”, the answer is the same: “Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him”.

Nobody can make you do anything, but they can influence you. Following a multitude into evil or following the people nearest you into evil is still following, and the commandment is not to. Do not give anyone that credit and let them cause you to lose your crown.

precepts.text: However close or trusted the person, accept no person against thy soul; your salvation is at stake.
precepts.point: This is why Leviticus 5:1 is opened at the start of class: if you know of anything, you are supposed to utter it. Many grew up on snitches get stitches, but in repentance we have to understand that concealing sin is part of why Israel is in the condition it is in, and we have to teach righteousness. It is that simple.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
“Accept no person against thy soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause thee to fall.” The people named here are the closest to you, the ones that can have influence on you: thy brother, thy son, thy daughter, the wife of thy bosom, the friend which is as thine own soul. However close or trusted the person, accept no person against thy soul; your salvation is at stake.

Trust in a person is no cover for your soul. When someone you love and trust has the devil on them, they will lead you astray. That is why the law says “neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare”: the reverence you have for a man cannot be allowed to cause thee to fall. Nobody can make you do anything, but they can influence you; do not give anyone that credit and let them cause you to lose your crown.

precepts.text: If a soul hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, and do not utter it, he shall bear his iniquity; utter what you know instead of concealing it.
precepts.point: This is why Leviticus 5:1 is opened at the start of class: if you know of anything, you are supposed to utter it. Many grew up on snitches get stitches, but in repentance we have to understand that concealing sin is part of why Israel is in the condition it is in, and we have to teach righteousness. It is that simple.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
“And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.” This is why Leviticus 5:1 is opened at the start of class: if you know of anything, you are supposed to utter it. Of the one who entices to other gods the law says “neither shalt thou conceal him”, meaning hide him; when wickedness is concealed, the whole nation is put in jeopardy. When it is uttered and dealt with, “all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.”

Many grew up on snitches get stitches. But in repentance we have to understand that concealing sin is part of why Israel is in the condition it is in, and we have to teach righteousness. The witness who does not utter what he knows bears the iniquity himself; utter what you know instead of concealing it. It is that simple.

precepts.text: Achan of the tribe of Judah took of the accursed thing, and the anger of the Lord was kindled against the children of Israel.
precepts.point: All Israel stoned Achan with stones and burned him with fire in the valley of Achor, and the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger; righteous judgment lifted the wrath and the people were able to move forward.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
When a city is withdrawn to serve other gods, the law does not strike at once. First “enquire, and make search, and ask diligently”, and only “if it be truth, and the thing certain” is the city smitten with the edge of the sword and burnt with fire. Achan is the example of this kind of judgment.

“But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against the children of Israel.” One man of the tribe of Judah took it, and one man's folly kindled the anger of the Lord against all Israel.

Wars Israel had been winning without losing a man began to be lost, and Joshua had to search and seek out who had committed the crime in Israel. That searching is the enquire, make search, and ask diligently of this law, done before anyone was judged.

precepts.text: Joshua and all Israel brought Achan and all he had to the valley of Achor and stoned them with stones; so the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger.
precepts.point: All Israel stoned Achan with stones and burned him with fire in the valley of Achor, and the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger; righteous judgment lifted the wrath and the people were able to move forward.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

precepts.why:
Once the thing was certain, the judgment fell the way this law lays it out. “And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.” All that he had went with him, as the city was to be destroyed utterly, “and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof”, with all the spoil gathered and burnt.

“And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones. And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day.” Stoned, burned with fire, and left a heap, as the city was to be “an heap for ever”.

“So the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger.” Righteous judgment lifted the wrath, and the people were able to move forward. That is why the place was called the valley of Achor unto this day.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why:
Here’s the understanding of cutting off the hand; it ain’t talking about your literal hand. “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul”: you love them so much, you love your friend which is as thine own soul. “Entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers; Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth”.

“Thou shalt not consent unto him”: don’t listen to him, “nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him”: don’t pity him, “neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him”: don’t try to hide it. “But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.”

So under Moses we literally had to kill our brother, our wife, our son, our daughter, our friend. Now we know Christ ain’t telling us to literally kill nobody; he’s just saying cut him off.

note.label: Pride & Divine Judgment

precepts.why:
What it means to cut off the hand that offends you: “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers; Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth”. What we going to do? “Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him: But thou shalt surely kill him”. That was under Moses: “thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death”.

Look at verse 6 again: or your precious little daughter; or the wife of your bosom, you brother, you just so in love; or some of you got a friend you cannot do without, “which is as thine own soul”, that friend grew up with you all your life. “Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him”. With that thought, the hand in Mark 9 is that person close to you.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Breakdown Of Revelation 16

precepts.why: “For the Lord your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.” God will allow you to be tested. Some tests we win and some we might lose, but when you lose, don’t run out of the truth: like Sirach says, if you are put down in the low estate, endure it and rise back up.

note.label: Living Martyrs

precepts.why:
What does it mean by your hand, your eye, your foot? “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods”, “Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.”

Your hand, your eye, is your brother, the son of your mother, your son or your daughter, your wife that is in your bosom, or your friend which is as thine own soul, because they are important to you in your life. When one of them entices you away from God, the law says do not consent and do not spare. That is what Christ means by if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: cut off the one close to you who keeps you in sin.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 10 The Little Book, Sweet and Bitter

precepts.why: An easier example. “If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder”: before we had the set-up we have now, there were women who claimed to be prophetesses; one said we would be destroyed in six months, and that was 16 years ago. “For the Lord your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart”: in the Christian churches they say I got a word of knowledge from God for you, and it may come to pass, but its purpose is to take you away from the commandments. That is the Lord testing you. “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly”: “thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death.” This is why it gets bitter: there are people in our lives we love dearly, but we know they are wicked; some of us it is our mothers, fathers, children, husband or wife.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
“All my familiars watched for my halting”: all my familiars are all my family members, all my kinsmen, all my friends. They watch for my halting, they watch for me to fall, because they hate God’s laws.

“Saying, Peradventure he will be enticed”: hopefully he’ll be enticed by the big butt woman over there. “And we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.” Why revenge? Because they hated God’s law. That is the brother, the son, the daughter, the wife and the friend of Deuteronomy 13:6: the enticer is in your own circle, waiting for you to fall.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
“Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword. For I am come to set a man at variance against his father”. God’s laws in Christ will set a man at variance against his father, “and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law. And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.” Your enemies will be in your house, first and foremost.

“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me”: that’s what Moses warned us about in Deuteronomy 13. “And he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.” Some of y’all go out of your way to get your rebellious children from a rebellious wife because you want full custody, and when you get that child back the child says, ‘I don’t want to keep no damn commandments, I want to hang in the streets.’ Now you’re stuck, because you love that child so much, and it was a rebellious child, a hateful child. You women, the same with y’all.

“And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.” If you ain’t willing to put your life on the line and die, Christ said you’re not worthy to be his disciple.

“He that findeth his life shall lose it”: you try to find your life: ‘I want to get my family back, I know they hate God but I want them back, I’m gonna leave the commandments out of love for my wicked kids and my wicked wife or my wicked husband.’ “And he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it”: losing your life means they’re all cut off, the wicked wife is gone, the wicked kids, the wicked husband, the wicked friends that are trying to get you to sin. Lose your life; be willing to go so far as to sacrifice your life in your faith for this truth.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
“Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide”: sometimes your friend can go off, a guide can go off. There is always that possibility to stumble in this truth, to fall in this truth, and that’s why you don’t put your 100 percent trust in somebody. “Keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom”: you don’t put all your trust in the woman that lies on your bosom. Samson did, and look what happened to him. It didn’t go well for Samson and it ain’t gonna go well for you either. ‘I’ma tell my wife everything’: you’re simple as hell.

“For the son dishonoureth the father”: some of you love them kids so much and your own kids disrespect you. “The daughter riseth up against her mother”: some of you women know your daughter can’t stand you. “A man’s enemies are the men of his own house”: that’s the same thing Christ said in Matthew 10:36.

“Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy”: a lot of times we read that and say it’s the other nations, but it’s talking about the people in your house who hate God, and hate you for loving God. “When I fall, I shall arise”: they’re waiting for you to fall, and when you fall and stumble in this truth they mock you, but when I fall I shall arise. “When I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.”

“I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him”: we know whatever we do against God’s law we’re going to suffer for it, but we know the Lord is merciful, “until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.”

“Then she that is mine enemy shall see it”: she is your wife. She hated the commandments, and when you fell she wanted you dead, but you rose up, you repented, and she shall see it. “And shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God?” That’s the same thing Job’s wife said: ‘where’s the Lord your God, keeping your damn commandments?’ “Mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.” God says don’t worry, I got her; her judgment is death, I’m going to kill her in time. You simp brothers need to understand it: if these women can’t get their act together, not these lovely women here, God says I’m going to kill her. That ain’t what I said; that’s what the Bible says.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
Those men and women that entice you to sin are part of this world. They don’t want to be woken up to God’s light; they don’t want to come out of darkness into the marvellous light. They will fight you, they will kick you, they will call the police on you for trying to get them to keep God’s commandments.

“If thou be among the indiscreet, observe the time”: the indiscreet are men and women who don’t keep the commandments. If you’re around them, check your watch, check yourself: what time is it? ‘I’ve been with you two minutes, I got to go.’ You do got something to do, like repent. Leave them. “But be continually among men of understanding.”

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
These are the type of folks you need to cut off. “And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness”: fellowship means friendship. Y’all going to the bar together, hanging out at each other’s house: have no fellowship. “But rather reprove them”: rather correct them.

“For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.” Some of the vile filth they do in secret: threesomes and foursomes, wife swapping. In one of our camps, sister A and sister B, friends who love ‘the sisterhood’, got to talking about what each one’s man was like. A month went by, two months of that type of conversation, and then one of the sisters said, how about we switch. That should have been a red flag. One husband was down for it already, because that’s what they did in the world; the other was reluctant at first, but then he did it, and they switched partners, four people in one bed. You’d be shocked at the things that have occurred, and you know where to throw them: out.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
Running with the man bragging about who he did yesterday is the unfruitful work of darkness, and what do you think is going to end up happening? You’re going to be seduced. That’s how a lot of you brothers end up back in the world: hanging around the wrong people. You hang around five dummies, you gonna be the sixth. Sisters, you hang around five hoes, you’re gonna be the sixth. ‘I’m not a hoe, I just hang around them’: you’re simple as hell.

“Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.” Sisters send messages asking, I got some friends in the world, is it okay if I hang out with them? Those messages get ignored and deleted. If you’ve been with us a year you can’t be that stupid, to ask if you can hang out with friends in the world that you know are drug dealers and drug users.

In Old Town, at a hotel, an LGBT dude came up talking about ‘what do you want for dinner’. You’re fooling nobody. You’re a Transformer, you are not a woman: more than meets the eye. They want you to join in their delusion: call me her, use my pronoun. So to be a part of this world means to be an enemy of God.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why: “Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world”: like that rap music some of y’all still listen to, all that worldly stuff some of y’all are still involved in and don’t want to let go. “If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.” The love of the Father is not in you. Yes, it is hard, but that’s why repenting is a daily thing, and we got to study, pray, apply daily.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
“I pray for them”: Christ is praying for the twelve. “I pray not for the world”: he doesn’t pray for the world, meaning the Israelites that are outside. “But for them which thou hast given me”: that was the twelve first and foremost, and those disciples at the time. “And all mine are thine”: all mine meaning my disciples.

“Holy Father, keep through thine own name”: letting you know the Father and the Son are two different powers. “That they may be one, as we are”: one meaning on one accord, in agreement. It ain’t talking about one person.

“None of them is lost, but the son of perdition”: that’s Judas Iscariot. He was the son of perdition, the betrayer.

“I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them”. When you get into this Bible and start applying it, expect to be hated. That’s the ADL read at the beginning of class: they hate our people that are in the scriptures. They ain’t worried about Christians; Christians are under delusion. But the Israelites, they hate our guts, and they push the term ‘hate group’ on us, when in reality they’re the hate group.

“Because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world”, “but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.” So when 1 John says love not the world, it’s talking about the evil: the men and women that live in the world. They are evil, and that’s what God wants us to understand.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

precepts.why:
“Neither pray I for these alone”: not just the twelve disciples and the disciples that were with them, “but for them also which shall believe on me through their word”. That’s us today, you and me.

“That they all may be one”: meaning perfectly joined in unity, one mind, “as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.” Christ is showing that the twelve are going to have one mind and always be together.

Today Israel is in the land of its oppressors and cannot exact that judgment, and no kind of violence is advocated; the deceived and the deceiver are his, and the judgment belongs to the Most High.

What is done today: mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned, and avoid them. The doctrine learned is the law, for I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

Going contrary to the laws of marriage, of the sabbath, of raising children righteously, or of going to thy brother alone when there is an ought between you, and secretly enticing others to follow, is how one turns people away from the Lord; those men and those women have to be put out from among the body.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: If thy brother, thy son, thy daughter, the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend which is as thine own soul entice thee secretly to serve other gods: these are the people closest to you, the ones that can have influence on you.

Trust in a person is no cover for your soul: when someone you love and trust has the devil on them, they will lead you astray. Nobody can make you do anything, but they can influence you; do not give anyone that credit and let them cause you to lose your crown.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: Thou shalt not consent, nor hearken, nor pity, nor spare, neither shalt thou conceal him, meaning hide him; when wickedness is concealed, the whole nation is put in jeopardy.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: Achan is the example of this kind of judgment: Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing, and one man's folly kindled the anger of the Lord against all Israel. Wars Israel had been winning without losing a man began to be lost, and Joshua had to search and seek out who had committed the crime in Israel.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: If certain men, the children of Belial, withdraw the inhabitants of a city, saying, let us go and serve other gods: inquire, make search, and ask diligently, and if it be truth and the thing certain, that city was smitten with the edge of the sword, gathered into the midst of the street, and burnt with fire, an heap for ever, not to be built again.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: All Israel stoned Achan with stones and burned him with fire in the valley of Achor, and the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger; righteous judgment lifted the wrath and the people were able to move forward.

note.label: Deuteronomy 13: Enticers to Other Gods Put Away

points: Christ spoke of hell fire, and Moses spoke about the same thing. This is for the churchgoers and the Christians: “If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder”. Growing up in church there was always some woman who had a word of knowledge from God: ‘God got a message for you young man, you’re going to be a man of the Lord, you’re going to do great things.’ You see them on TV: send the money, get a prayer cloth, a word of knowledge, you’re going to get healed. There was a famous dude to the stars, always with a word of knowledge, a word of wisdom, God showed him something about the rich and famous.
It sounds like this: ‘I had a dream about you the other night,’ or ‘I had a vision that you’re going to get a job on the third Wednesday of October.’

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

points: “And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them”. Once that sign or wonder comes to pass they convince you. They won’t say ‘other gods’, they’ll say ‘let’s go worship Jesus, come on to my church’, Baptist, Mormon, Episcopal, Anglican: ‘that dream, that vision I had toward you, that’s from the Lord, let’s go worship him.’

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

points: “Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams”. Why not? “For the Lord your God proveth you”: God is testing you, “to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.”

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

points: “Ye shall walk after the Lord your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments”. If the dream or the vision that comes to pass is trying to get you to go against God’s commandments, that’s how you know it’s false. It’s not of the Lord. God is testing you, proving you.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

points: “And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death”: under Moses’ law he or she was to be put to death, “because he hath spoken to turn you away from the Lord your God”. Their whole objective was to get you to worship a false god.

People ask, why did God do this, the brother’s or the sister’s vision or dream came to pass? Dummy, have you not been reading your four chapters a day? Study, pray, apply. You’ve been warned: reading four chapters a day you had to come across Deuteronomy 13. Your mama had a dream, your bishop or your priest had a dream or a vision about you, and the job came, the money came, the marriage came, the baby came. Some of these women can’t get pregnant and they’re told, you’re going to get pregnant next month, the 14th day of November, and now she’s pregnant. The Lord allowed all that to happen, because now they say: come on to church, come worship white jesus, you ain’t got to keep no law. And you go, okay. You have just failed the test, and now it’s hell fire for your black behind.

note.label: Lazarus and the Lake of Fire

points: This verse goes with Matthew 18:8 and Matthew 5, the hand, the foot and the eye. “If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul”: it’s as if they’re a part of you. You grew up with them, you love them so intensely, it’s as if they’re a part of you, like an eye, like a hand, like a foot.

“Or thy son, or thy daughter”: you women read that. Believe it or not, some people have left the truth at the behest of their children: ‘mommy, daddy, I don’t want to be here,’ and out of love for that child mommy and daddy left the truth. True stories; there are a million of them.

“Or the wife of thy bosom”: you brothers can be strong, but when you get married the real you will come out. He was always a simp; he just put on a good show. Marry a woman and love her beyond God, and the real simp nature comes out, seeping through your pores, and you stand up for wickedness. There’s a recent story of a brother, an officer in New York, speaking up on behalf of a rebellious girl that was just put out, saying we judged her wrong. In Florida, at one of our schools, the scripture says the woman shall not wear what man wears, and the sister told her husband, ‘I got a spandex dress, men don’t wear this,’ and he said, ‘I love you so much babe, you’re right.’ She walked her behind into the school in a spandex dress so tight her feet could only go so far in front of each other, and the captain said, ‘what the hell do y’all think y’all doing,’ and thank God the captain threw both of them out that night. Those are the v-o-g brothers: brothers that put vagina over God.

“Or thy friend”: some of you come in here for friendship, and your friend falls out of the truth and you fall out with him. You’re simple as hell. Every man was called into this truth alone. You were born alone, you’re gonna die alone.

“Entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods”: they won’t necessarily say those words. They’ll say, ‘hey, let’s go commit adultery; I know the god you serve says thou shalt not commit adultery, but my god says thou shalt commit adultery.’ That is what Matthew 5 was talking about: cut it off, pluck your eye out, cut your hand off, cut your foot off, because they are as your soul. Some of y’all are scared to cut off these wicked kids, the wicked wife, the wicked husband. Cut them off, because they’re going to lead you down the rabbit hole of sin.
